literature.headline_zh: 狂犬病病毒本期文献呈现多方向研究进展
literature.lead_zh: 本期狂犬病病毒研究集中呈现以下进展。
key_findings_zh: 数学分析确认解的正性和有界性,建立全局解的存在性和唯一性,确定无病平衡,并导出基本繁殖数 R0,定义局部感染建立的阈值。 [10.21203/rs.3.rs-11327433/v1]

在评估的候选者中,MKMKCHTTATMKIV (P40) 显示出最有利的对接,HADDOCK 得分为 − 90 ± 3.8,结合自由能为 -10.3kcal/mol,其次是 CLDLGYTIVCHTTATSPI (P3)、MKIVCHTTATSPMKV (P21) 和 MKIVCHTTMKSPMK (P25)。分子动力学模拟(100ns)分析表明,P40和P25与RABV-G形成高度稳定的复合物,在分子间相互作用下表现出低RMSD和RMSF波动,并在整个模拟过程中表现出良好的自由能景观和稳定的构象。 [10.1007/s40203-026-00796-0]
在重症支持护理下,患者从急性疾病中幸存下来,但因持续的神经功能缺损而出院。 [10.4269/ajtmh.26-0401]
内部诊断覆盖率从一级医院的11.6%提高到二级医院的27.9%和三级医院的39.5%。包括发送测试在内的总体覆盖率分别为 14%、32.6% 和 44.2%。乙型肝炎检测已广泛应用,但肺结核检测显示出明显的分级梯度。对于低 发病率 但后果严重的感染,特定检测方式的可用性有限,并且地理差异部分与已知的疾病流行情况一致。 [10.2196/107757]
该研究报告称,柬埔寨的国家 疫苗 政策传统上侧重于儿童免疫接种,但针对新出现的传染病的准备需要更广泛的战略,包括 疫苗、基因组监测、监管准备、快速 疫苗 平台和 One Health 合作。 [10.7189/jogh.16.03041]
literature.trend_or_risk_zh: 本期研究方向以入选文献实际覆盖的临床、流行病学、宿主生态、诊断或分子监测主题为准。
literature.lead_en: This reporting window highlights the following research developments.
key_findings_en: Mathematical analysis confirms the positivity and boundedness of solutions, establishes the existence and uniqueness of a global solution, identifies a disease-free equilibrium, and derives a basic reproduction number R0 defining a threshold for local infection establishment. [10.21203/rs.3.rs-11327433/v1]

Among the evaluated candidates, MKMKCHTTATMKIV (P40) shown the most favourable docking with a HADDOCK scores − 90 ± 3.8, and binding free energy of -10.3kcal/mol, followed by CLDLGYTIVCHTTATSPI (P3), MKIVCHTTATSPMKV (P21), and MKIVCHTTMKSPMK (P25). [10.1007/s40203-026-00796-0]
Between 1990 and 2023, the burden of rabies in Ethiopia declined significantly. [10.4102/jphia.v17i2.2262]
With intensive supportive care, the patient survived the acute illness but was discharged with persistent neurological deficits. [10.4269/ajtmh.26-0401]

In-house diagnostic coverage increased from 11.6% in primary hospitals to 27.9% in secondary hospitals and 39.5% in tertiary hospitals. Overall coverage, including send-out testing, was 14%, 32.6%, and 44.2% respectively. [10.2196/107757]

news.headline_zh: 狂犬病病毒本期公共卫生新闻动态
news.lead_zh: 本期狂犬病病毒新闻集中呈现以下动态。
key_findings_zh: 吉尔福德县于 2026 年确认了第 18 起动物 狂犬病 病例,涉及斯托克斯代尔麦克罗里路 (McCrory Road) 的一只臭鼬。该报告由吉尔福德县卫生与公众服务机构 - 公共卫生部发布。 [news-ac219f8cf25497bd]
据 Contagion Live 报道,欧盟批准赛诺菲的 狂犬病 疫苗 VaxRabeo 用于所有年龄段。 [news-6383850bfa37c9d1]
欧盟委员会批准赛诺菲的 狂犬病 疫苗 VaxRabeo 用于所有年龄段个体的暴露前预防 (PrEP) 和 暴露后预防 (PEP)。这是基于人用药品委员会的积极意见,疫苗 的首次营销授权。 [news-a66fcd17211ed132]
确诊一例人类 狂犬病 病例,卫生部正在调查可能的暴露情况。该妇女情况危急,卫生部正在努力查明其他可能接触过该感染患者的人。 [news-90e434d707d3988e]
吉尔福德县斯托克斯代尔发现一只臭鼬患有狂犬病,并检测出 狂犬病病毒 呈阳性。据吉尔福德县卫生与公众服务局公共卫生部报告,这是该县 2026 年第 18 例确诊的动物 狂犬病 病例。 [news-152c93039977d6ca]
news.trend_or_risk_zh: 风险判断仅依据入选来源已经确认的信息，不把媒体推测升级为官方结论。
news.lead_en: This reporting window highlights the following Rabies virus news developments.
key_findings_en: Guilford County confirmed an eighteenth case of animal rabies in 2026, involving a skunk on McCrory Road in Stokesdale. The report was issued by the Guilford County Health and Human Services Agency - Department of Public Health. [news-ac219f8cf25497bd]
The EU approved Sanofi's Rabies vaccine VaxRabeo for all age groups, as reported by Contagion Live. [news-6383850bfa37c9d1]

The European Commission approved Sanofi's rabies vaccine VaxRabeo for pre-exposure prophylaxis (PrEP) and post-exposure prophylaxis (PEP) in individuals of all ages. This is the first marketing authorization for the vaccine, based on a positive opinion from the Committee for Medicinal Products for Human Use. [news-a66fcd17211ed132]

A human rabies case was diagnosed, and the Health Ministry is investigating possible exposures. The woman is in critical condition, and the ministry is working to identify others who may have been exposed to the infected patient. [news-90e434d707d3988e]

A skunk was found rabid in Stokesdale, Guilford County, and tested positive for the rabies virus. This is the 18th confirmed animal rabies case in the county in 2026, reported by the Guilford County Health and Human Services Agency’s Department of Public Health. [news-152c93039977d6ca]

papers.title: An intra-host mathematical model for rabies infection with structured axonal transport and post-exposure control strategies
papers.abstract: We propose a novel intra-host mathematical model for rabies virus infection, which mechanistically integrates the main stages of viral progression from the inoculation site to the salivary glands. The model is formulated as a system of nonlinear ordinary differential equations coupling the dynamics of local muscle infection, nonlinear viral capture by peripheral nerve endings (modeled by a Hill function), structured retrograde axonal transport as a chain of successive compartments, central nervous system invasion, salivary dissemination, a local effector immune response, and three time-dependent post-exposure control strategies. A key novelty lies in the explicit representation of the neurotropic progression of the virus via discrete axonal steps, offering a suitable framework to study therapeutic windows and optimized interventions. Mathematical analysis establishes the positivity and boundedness of solutions as well as the existence and uniqueness of a global solution. A disease-free equilibrium is identified, and a basic reproduction number R 0 is derived, defining a threshold for local infection establishment. A local stability condition is stated, and a Lya-punov function is constructed to demonstrate the global asymptotic stability of the disease-free equilibrium when R 0 < 1, valid for any Hill cooperativity q ≥ 1. A mechanistic neuroinvasion index R n is also proposed to quantify the probability of virus progression to the central nervous system via the axonal chain. Finally, an optimal control problem is formulated to minimize viral load and salivary dissemination under intervention cost constraints, necessary optimality conditions are derived via Pontryagin’s maximum principle, and the resulting optimality system is solved numerically via a forward–backward sweep method, whose performance is benchmarked against a constant-effort strategy. This model constitutes a rigorous basis for evaluating post-exposure prophylactic strategies.

papers.title: Computational design and prioritization of putative peptide inhibitors targeting rabies virus glycoprotein using machine learning, molecular docking, and molecular dynamics
papers.abstract: Rabies is the most lethal viral zoonotic diseases worldwide. The rabies virus glycoprotein (RABV-G) which mediates host cell recognition and viral entry; it represents a therapeutic target for the development of novel anti-viral agents. In the present study, a computational peptide design strategy was employed to design peptide inhibitors against RABV-G. Peptide sequences were designed from the receptor binding region of α-bungarotoxin through mutation and optimisation while eliminating neurotoxic properties. A hybrid machine learning-deep framework was used for toxicity screening. The selected non-toxic peptides were analysed through framework of different tools for Physiochemical characterization, antiviral activity prediction, molecular docking, binding affinity and molecular dynamic simulation were performed to analyse peptide RABV-G interactions. A three-dimensional model of RABV-G was generated using SWISS MODEL and validated through Ramchandran plot analysis with 92.5% residues within favoured regions. Binding pocket analysis identified key residues involved in peptide binding including Glu272, Glu279., Asp283, Lys276 and Arg297. Among the evaluated candidates, MKMKCHTTATMKIV (P40) shown the most favourable docking with a HADDOCK scores − 90 ± 3.8, and binding free energy of -10.3kcal/mol, followed by CLDLGYTIVCHTTATSPI (P3), MKIVCHTTATSPMKV (P21), and MKIVCHTTMKSPMK (P25). Molecular dynamic simulations (100ns) analysed that P40 and P25 formed highly stable complexes with RABV-G, exhibiting low RMSD and RMSF fluctuation with intermolecular interaction, and favourable free energy landscapes and stable conformational through simulation period. This study design shows the α-bungarotoxin derived peptides can target RABV-G and P440 can be promising lead candidate for development of peptide-based drug delivery.

source_records.abstract: A critical, annotated version of Narlikar’s iconic novel about a cybervirus attack by an advanced alien species—with updated text and added material. A year before Robin Cook’s Invasion (1997)—in which an alien force activates a latent biological virus in humans—and almost a decade before Liu Cixin’s The Remembrance of Earth’s Past trilogy (2008–2010)—in which humanity’s scientific progress is curtailed by an alien supercomputer’s “sophon-lock”—Jayant Vishnu Narlikar’s Virus (1996) painted a similar scenario. In his novel, a cybervirus broadcast by an advanced, extraterrestrial species invades Earth and freezes its digital infrastructure: a prelude to an alien invasion. The novel, first published in Marathi, recounts how vast radio arrays on Earth intercept a seemingly innocuous message from an unknown planet orbiting Barnard’s Star. The radio signal, sent six years prior, coalesces into a cybervirus that has the potential to cause a complete digital meltdown and lead humanity into an age of chaos—an alien first strike to prevent humanity from evolving further. This book—a critical, annotated version of Virus, edited and revised by Sami Ahmad Khan—reissues Narlikar’s iconic novel with updated text and added dimensions. It includes detailed annotations that locate the technology of the text along the axis of contemporary scientific thought, as well as critical essays that focus on the literary, political, and sociocultural dimensions of the novel; essays on Narlikar’s role in India’s science and science fiction; an exclusive conversation with the author; bibliographical information on his works; and a bonus short story. Contributions by Sami Ahmad Khan, Nilam Ingole, Priteegandha Naik, Jayant V. Narlikar, and Dibyadyuti Roy.

papers.title_zh: 使用机器学习、分子对接和分子动力学对针对 狂犬病病毒 糖蛋白的假定肽抑制剂进行计算设计和优先排序
papers.source_body_en: Rabies is the most lethal viral zoonotic diseases worldwide. The rabies virus glycoprotein (RABV-G) which mediates host cell recognition and viral entry; it represents a therapeutic target for the development of novel anti-viral agents. In the present study, a computational peptide design strategy was employed to design peptide inhibitors against RABV-G. Peptide sequences were designed from the receptor binding region of α-bungarotoxin through mutation and optimisation while eliminating neurotoxic properties. A hybrid machine learning-deep framework was used for toxicity screening. The selected non-toxic peptides were analysed through framework of different tools for Physiochemical characterization, antiviral activity prediction, molecular docking, binding affinity and molecular dynamic simulation were performed to analyse peptide RABV-G interactions. A three-dimensional model of RABV-G was generated using SWISS MODEL and validated through Ramchandran plot analysis with 92.5% residues within favoured regions. Binding pocket analysis identified key residues involved in peptide binding including Glu272, Glu279., Asp283, Lys276 and Arg297. Among the evaluated candidates, MKMKCHTTATMKIV (P40) shown the most favourable docking with a HADDOCK scores − 90 ± 3.8, and binding free energy of -10.3kcal/mol, followed by CLDLGYTIVCHTTATSPI (P3), MKIVCHTTATSPMKV (P21), and MKIVCHTTMKSPMK (P25). Molecular dynamic simulations (100ns) analysed that P40 and P25 formed highly stable complexes with RABV-G, exhibiting low RMSD and RMSF fluctuation with intermolecular interaction, and favourable free energy landscapes and stable conformational through simulation period. This study design shows the α-bungarotoxin derived peptides can target RABV-G and P440 can be promising lead candidate for development of peptide-based drug delivery.

papers.title: Burden and trends of human rabies in Ethiopia, 1990–2023: A national and subnational systematic analysis of the Global Burden of Disease Study 2023
papers.abstract: Background: Rabies remains a significant public health threat in low- and middle-income countries. Ethiopia ranks as the second most affected country in Africa, reporting over 2700 human deaths and 193 748 disability-adjusted life years (DALYs) annually. Despite existing control measures, challenges related to treatment accessibility and implementation persist. Aim: To estimate rabies-associated incidence, mortality and DALYs rate in Ethiopia from 1990 to 2023. Setting: Eleven regional states and two city administrations in Ethiopia. Methods: This study utilised data from Global Burden of Disease (GBD) 2023 study. Age-standardised incidence, mortality and DALY rates were estimated. Trends over time were examined using total percentage and annual percentage change with corresponding 95% uncertainty intervals (UIs). Variations by age groups, regions and year were compared. Results: Between 1990 and 2023, the burden of rabies in Ethiopia declined significantly. The incidence rate decreased from 8.4 (95% UI: 1.1, 28.7) to 1.4 (95% UI: 0.18, 4.7); mortality declined from 7.4 (95% UI: 0.79, 27.3) to 1.4 (95% UI: 0.18, 4.6); and DALYs dropped from 439.4 (95% UI: 49.3, 1605.6) to 78.3 (95% UI: 9.5, 257.9) per 100 000 population. Individuals aged 5–14 years bore the highest rabies burden in all metrics. The Southwest, Southern Nations, Nationalities, and Peoples’ Regional State, Amhara, and Oromia regions exhibited the highest rabies burden in Ethiopia. Conclusion: Despite the burden of human rabies decreasing significantly between 1990 and 2023 in Ethiopia, the problem persists with substantial variations across age groups, regions and years. Contribution: These findings underscore the need for targeted human rabies prevention and control strategies in Ethiopia by identifying high-burden geographic areas and the age groups at greatest risk.
papers.journal: Journal of Public Health in Africa

papers.title: Engineering a low cytotoxicity recombinant rabies virus neurotracer via N-gene recoding
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT Viral-vector-based tracers have proven invaluable for mapping neural circuits. Rabies virus (RV)-based retrograde trans-monosynaptic tracers have been widely used for depicting the input neural circuit of targeted neuronal populations. However, the cytotoxicity of the RV tracer limits its application. Here, we employed the synthetic attenuated virus engineering technology to recode the N gene of the RV SAD-B19 strain by codon pair deoptimization to generate attenuated RV tracers. The characteristics of the recoded RV tracers were tested both in vitro and in vivo . The full-length recoded N gene abolished viral rescue, whereas the partial recoded N gene supported successful viral recovery. Compared to its parent, the recoded RV trans-monosynaptic tracer exhibited lower cytotoxicity and labeled more input neurons. It can also robustly express proteins to visualize the neuronal morphology and manipulate the neural circuit activity. Collectively, our work generated a new retrograde trans-monosynaptic tool, which complements existing neural circuit tracers. IMPORTANCE Viral vectors play an important role across multiple fields in biomedicine. In the neuroscience community, rabies virus (RV)-based retrograde trans-monosynaptic tracers have been widely used to map the input neural circuits of targeted neuronal populations. However, the inherent cytotoxicity of RV-based tracers limits their broader application. In this study, we utilized synthetic attenuated virus engineering technology to recode the RV N gene, generating an attenuated neurotracer that will significantly benefit future neuroscience research.

papers.title: Atypical Rabies Encephalomyelitis Following Incomplete Post-Exposure Prophylaxis: Delayed Serological Diagnosis and Survival in an Adolescent.
papers.abstract: Rabies is an almost invariably fatal viral encephalitis classically characterized by hydrophobia and aerophobia. Atypical presentations lacking these hallmark features are uncommon and frequently result in diagnostic delay, particularly in partially immunized individuals. Reported is a 15-year-old previously healthy boy who developed progressive encephalomyelitis 25 days after sustaining a Category III jackal bite. Although he completed post-exposure rabies vaccination, rabies immunoglobulin was not administered. He presented with quadriparesis and altered sensorium without hydrophobia or aerophobia. Initial rabies reverse transcription polymerase chain reaction (RT-PCR) and cerebrospinal fluid (CSF) antibody testing were negative. Serial evaluation subsequently demonstrated rising rabies virus-neutralizing antibody titers in both serum and CSF, confirming rabies encephalitis. With intensive supportive care, the patient survived the acute illness but was discharged with persistent neurological deficits. This case highlights the diagnostic challenges of atypical rabies and underscores the importance of complete post-exposure prophylaxis.
papers.journal: The American journal of tropical medicine and hygiene

source_records.abstract: Rabies is an almost invariably fatal viral encephalitis classically characterized by hydrophobia and aerophobia. Atypical presentations lacking these hallmark features are uncommon and frequently result in diagnostic delay, particularly in partially immunized individuals. Reported is a 15-year-old previously healthy boy who developed progressive encephalomyelitis 25 days after sustaining a Category III jackal bite. Although he completed post-exposure rabies vaccination, rabies immunoglobulin was not administered. He presented with quadriparesis and altered sensorium without hydrophobia or aerophobia. Initial rabies reverse transcription polymerase chain reaction (RT-PCR) and cerebrospinal fluid (CSF) antibody testing were negative. Serial evaluation subsequently demonstrated rising rabies virus-neutralizing antibody titers in both serum and CSF, confirming rabies encephalitis. With intensive supportive care, the patient survived the acute illness but was discharged with persistent neurological deficits. This case highlights the diagnostic challenges of atypical rabies and underscores the importance of complete post-exposure prophylaxis.

analysis.summary_en: This case report describes an adolescent who developed atypical rabies encephalomyelitis following an incomplete post-exposure prophylaxis regimen after a Category III jackal bite. The patient exhibited symptoms such as quadriparesis and altered sensorium without the classic signs of hydrophobia or aerophobia. Initial diagnostic tests, including rabies reverse transcription polymerase chain reaction (RT-PCR) and cerebrospinal fluid (CSF) antibody testing, were negative, but serial evaluation revealed rising rabies virus-neutralizing antibody titers in serum and CSF, confirming the diagnosis. Despite the absence of rabies immunoglobulin, the patient survived with persistent neurological deficits. The case emphasizes the diagnostic challenges of atypical rabies and the necessity of complete post-exposure prophylaxis. The study is a single case report, which limits the generalizability of the findings, and the evidence is based on clinical observations and serological testing, which may not be sufficient to establish broader implications.

papers.title: The molecular interactions of viruses with apolipoproteins: Evidence, Mechanisms, and Therapeutic Implications.
papers.abstract: Host lipid metabolism is extensively hijacked by viruses to support their replication cycle. Apolipoproteins, the core protein components of lipoprotein particles, mediate lipid transport, receptor recognition, and immune regulation, making them key host targets for diverse viruses. This review systematically examines the molecular mechanisms underlying virus-apolipoprotein interactions and establishes a classification framework distinguishing direct from indirect modes of action. Direct interactions involve physical binding between viral components and apolipoproteins or their receptors, exemplified by hepatitis C virus (HCV) ApoE-dependent lipoviroparticle assembly, hepatitis B virus (HBV) ApoE-mediated entry, Severe Acute Respiratory Syndrome Coronavirus 2 (SARS-CoV-2) spike protein binding to high-density lipoprotein (HDL)-associated apolipoproteins, and rabies virus ApoD-glycoprotein interaction. Indirect mechanisms include viral regulation of apolipoprotein expression through epigenetic modifications, cytokines, and oxidative stress. We also compare the differential effects of ApoE2, ApoE3, and ApoE4 subtypes on infection susceptibility and disease severity across HCV, human immunodeficiency virus type 1 (HIV-1), and SARS-CoV-2. The clinical-pathological consequences, including hepatic steatosis, atherosclerosis (AS), dyslipidemia, and thrombotic complications, are discussed, and therapeutic strategies targeting lipid metabolism are critically evaluated. We close by outlining unresolved questions and suggesting future research directions leveraging single-cell multi-omics, spatial biology, and organoid models.

This review systematically examines the molecular mechanisms underlying virus-apolipoprotein interactions and establishes a classification framework distinguishing direct from indirect modes of action. Direct interactions involve physical binding between viral components and apolipoproteins or their receptors, exemplified by hepatitis C virus (HCV) ApoE-dependent lipoviroparticle assembly, hepatitis B virus (HBV) ApoE-mediated entry, Severe Acute Respiratory Syndrome Coronavirus 2 (SARS-CoV-2) spike protein binding to high-density lipoprotein (HDL)-associated apolipoproteins, and rabies virus ApoD-glycoprotein interaction. Indirect mechanisms include viral regulation of apolipoprotein expression through epigenetic modifications, cytokines, and oxidative stress. We also compare the differential effects of ApoE2, ApoE3, and ApoE4 subtypes on infection susceptibility and disease severity across HCV, human immunodeficiency virus type 1 (HIV-1), and SARS-CoV-2. The clinical-pathological consequences, including hepatic steatosis, atherosclerosis (AS), dyslipidemia, and thrombotic complications, are discussed, and therapeutic strategies targeting lipid metabolism are critically evaluated. We close by outlining unresolved questions and suggesting future research directions leveraging single-cell multi-omics, spatial biology, and organoid models.

analysis.scope_and_question: This review focuses on rabies virus and rabies disease, examining its molecular interactions with apolipoproteins. The central question is how rabies virus exploits host lipid metabolism and apolipoproteins to support its replication cycle and pathogenesis.
analysis.evidence_base_and_review_method: The review is a systematic analysis of molecular mechanisms of virus-apolipoprotein interactions. It includes a classification framework distinguishing direct and indirect modes of action, with evidence drawn from studies on rabies virus, hepatitis C virus (HCV), human immunodeficiency virus type 1 (HIV-1), and SARS-CoV-2. The review does not explicitly report meta-analysis or pooled estimates.
analysis.consensus_and_key_conclusions: The review concludes that rabies virus interacts directly with apolipoproteins, such as ApoD, through its glycoprotein to facilitate infection. It also highlights indirect mechanisms where the virus modulates apolipoprotein expression via epigenetic changes, cytokines, and oxidative stress. These findings establish a framework for understanding the role of apolipoproteins in viral pathogenesis.
analysis.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: The review identifies gaps in understanding the differential effects of ApoE subtypes (ApoE2, ApoE3, ApoE4) on infection susceptibility and disease severity in rabies virus and other related viruses. Additionally, the mechanisms by which rabies virus influences lipid metabolism and its broader clinical implications remain underexplored.
analysis.research_and_practice_implications: The review suggests future research should focus on leveraging single-cell multi-omics, spatial biology, and organoid models to better understand the molecular interactions between rabies virus and apolipoproteins. These approaches could inform the development of targeted therapeutic strategies for rabies disease.

analysis.summary_en: This review explores the molecular interactions of rabies virus with apolipoproteins, emphasizing how these interactions support viral replication and pathogenesis. It outlines both direct and indirect mechanisms, including physical binding to apolipoproteins and regulation of their expression. The study highlights the role of apolipoproteins in lipid transport, immune regulation, and disease progression, while identifying gaps in understanding the impact of ApoE subtypes on infection outcomes. The review concludes with recommendations for future research using advanced technologies to uncover new therapeutic targets for rabies disease.

elements_zh.scope_and_question: 本综述重点关注 狂犬病病毒 和 狂犬病 疾病,检查其与载脂蛋白的分子相互作用。核心问题是 狂犬病病毒 如何利用 宿主 脂质代谢和载脂蛋白来支持其复制周期和 发病机制。
elements_zh.evidence_base_and_review_method: 该综述是对病毒-载脂蛋白相互作用的分子机制的系统分析。它包括区分直接和间接作用模式的分类框架,证据来自 狂犬病病毒、丙型肝炎病毒 (HCV)、人类免疫缺陷病毒 1 型 (HIV-1) 和 SARS-CoV-2 的研究。该综述没有明确报告荟萃分析或汇总估计。
elements_zh.consensus_and_key_conclusions: 综述得出的结论是,狂犬病病毒 通过其糖蛋白直接与载脂蛋白(如 ApoD)相互作用以促进感染。它还强调了病毒通过表观遗传变化、细胞因子和氧化应激调节载脂蛋白表达的间接机制。这些发现为理解载脂蛋白在病毒 发病机制 中的作用建立了一个框架。
elements_zh.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: 该综述指出了在理解 ApoE 亚型(ApoE2、ApoE3、ApoE4)对 狂犬病病毒 和其他相关病毒的感染易感性和疾病严重程度的差异影响方面存在的差距。此外,狂犬病病毒 影响脂质代谢的机制及其更广泛的临床意义仍有待探索。
elements_zh.research_and_practice_implications: 该评论建议未来的研究应侧重于利用单细胞多组学、空间生物学和类器官模型,以更好地了解 狂犬病病毒 和载脂蛋白之间的分子相互作用。这些方法可以为 狂犬病 疾病的靶向治疗策略的开发提供信息。

papers.abstract_zh: 宿主 脂质代谢被病毒广泛劫持以支持其复制周期。载脂蛋白是脂蛋白颗粒的核心蛋白成分,介导脂质转运、受体识别和免疫调节,使其成为多种病毒的关键 宿主 靶点。这篇综述系统地研究了病毒-载脂蛋白相互作用的分子机制,并建立了区分直接和间接作用模式的分类框架。直接相互作用涉及病毒成分和载脂蛋白或其受体之间的物理结合,例如丙型肝炎病毒(HCV)ApoE依赖性脂病毒颗粒组装、乙型肝炎病毒(HBV)ApoE介导的进入、严重急性呼吸综合征冠状病毒2(SARS-CoV-2)刺突蛋白与高密度脂蛋白(HDL)相关载脂蛋白的结合以及狂犬病病毒 ApoD-糖蛋白相互作用。间接机制包括病毒通过表观遗传修饰、细胞因子和氧化应激对载脂蛋白表达的调节。我们还比较了 ApoE2、ApoE3 和 ApoE4 亚型对 HCV、人类免疫缺陷病毒 1 型 (HIV-1) 和 SARS-CoV-2 感染易感性和疾病严重程度的不同影响。讨论了临床病理后果,包括肝脂肪变性、动脉粥样硬化(AS)、血脂异常和血栓并发症,并严格评估了针对脂质代谢的治疗策略。最后,我们概述了尚未解决的问题,并建议利用单细胞多组学、空间生物学和类器官模型的未来研究方向。

papers.title: Molecular basis of behavioral and cognitive changes induced by neurotropic viruses.
papers.abstract: Neurotropic viruses induce behavioral and cognitive alterations through diverse molecular and cellular mechanisms that extend beyond simple neuronal damage. Comparative analysis of rabies virus (RABV), pseudorabies virus (PRV), Borna disease virus (BoDV-1), SARS-CoV-2, Nipah virus (NiV), West Nile virus (WNV) and Herpes Simplex virus 1 (HSV-1) reveals distinct pathogenic strategies targeting specific neural circuits. While neuroinflammation characterized by microglial activation, astrocytic responses, and pro-inflammatory cytokine production contributes significantly to synaptic and network dysfunction in WNV and NiV infections, other mechanisms predominate in different pathogens. RABV selectively disrupts cholinergic, serotonergic, and glutamate/GABAergic pathways while preserving neuronal integrity to facilitate transmission, whereas BoDV-1 and SARS-CoV-2 induce dopaminergic and serotonergic dysfunctions through persistent immune activation and endothelial damage. Additionally, systemic factors such as the gut-brain axis and microbiome alterations, particularly evident in SARS-CoV-2 infection, modulate neurotransmitter metabolism and neuroimmune responses. Considering the lack of even diffuse neuronal loss observed during infection, behavioral changes may arise more from selective, circuit-dependent vulnerabilities, involving specific disruptions to emotion, cognition, and motor control networks. To provide a clear review of the knowledge regarding how targeted neuronal population alterations translate into behavioral phenotypes, we here integrate molecular, cellular, and systems-level insights across these seven neurotropic viruses used as models, with the aim of identifying common pathways linking infection to behavioral changes and cognitive dysfunction. Understanding these discrete mechanisms ranging from acute synaptic manipulation to long-lasting neuroimmune dysregulation is essential for developing therapeutic strategies that address both the infectious agent and the specific neural networks mediating acute disturbances and long-term neurological sequelae.

Comparative analysis of rabies virus (RABV), pseudorabies virus (PRV), Borna disease virus (BoDV-1), SARS-CoV-2, Nipah virus (NiV), West Nile virus (WNV) and Herpes Simplex virus 1 (HSV-1) reveals distinct pathogenic strategies targeting specific neural circuits. While neuroinflammation characterized by microglial activation, astrocytic responses, and pro-inflammatory cytokine production contributes significantly to synaptic and network dysfunction in WNV and NiV infections, other mechanisms predominate in different pathogens. RABV selectively disrupts cholinergic, serotonergic, and glutamate/GABAergic pathways while preserving neuronal integrity to facilitate transmission, whereas BoDV-1 and SARS-CoV-2 induce dopaminergic and serotonergic dysfunctions through persistent immune activation and endothelial damage. Additionally, systemic factors such as the gut-brain axis and microbiome alterations, particularly evident in SARS-CoV-2 infection, modulate neurotransmitter metabolism and neuroimmune responses. Considering the lack of even diffuse neuronal loss observed during infection, behavioral changes may arise more from selective, circuit-dependent vulnerabilities, involving specific disruptions to emotion, cognition, and motor control networks. To provide a clear review of the knowledge regarding how targeted neuronal population alterations translate into behavioral phenotypes, we here integrate molecular, cellular, and systems-level insights across these seven neurotropic viruses used as models, with the aim of identifying common pathways linking infection to behavioral changes and cognitive dysfunction. Understanding these discrete mechanisms ranging from acute synaptic manipulation to long-lasting neuroimmune dysregulation is essential for developing therapeutic strategies that address both the infectious agent and the specific neural networks mediating acute disturbances and long-term neurological sequelae.

analysis.scope_and_question: Rabies virus and rabies disease. The review focuses on understanding the molecular and cellular mechanisms by which rabies virus induces behavioral and cognitive changes, with an emphasis on targeted neuronal population alterations and their translation into behavioral phenotypes.
analysis.evidence_base_and_review_method: The review integrates molecular, cellular, and systems-level insights from studies on rabies virus (RABV), pseudorabies virus (PRV), Borna disease virus (BoDV-1), SARS-CoV-2, Nipah virus (NiV), West Nile virus (WNV), and Herpes Simplex virus 1 (HSV-1). It includes a comparative analysis of these viruses to identify common pathways linking infection to behavioral changes and cognitive dysfunction.
analysis.consensus_and_key_conclusions: Rabies virus selectively disrupts cholinergic, serotonergic, and glutamate/GABAergic pathways while preserving neuronal integrity to facilitate transmission. Neuroinflammation, including microglial activation, astrocytic responses, and pro-inflammatory cytokine production, contributes to synaptic and network dysfunction in WNV and NiV infections, but other mechanisms predominate in different pathogens. Systemic factors such as the gut-brain axis and microbiome alterations, particularly evident in SARS-CoV-2 infection, modulate neurotransmitter metabolism and neuroimmune responses.
analysis.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: The review highlights that while neuroinflammation is a significant factor in some viruses, other mechanisms predominate in different pathogens. There is a lack of detailed understanding of how specific neuronal population alterations translate into behavioral phenotypes, and the role of systemic factors in modulating these effects remains underexplored.
analysis.research_and_practice_implications: Further research is needed to elucidate the molecular and cellular mechanisms by which rabies virus and other neurotropic viruses induce behavioral and cognitive changes. This includes investigating the role of the gut-brain axis and microbiome alterations in modulating neuroimmune responses and neurotransmitter metabolism.

analysis.summary_en: This review explores the molecular and cellular mechanisms by which rabies virus induces behavioral and cognitive changes, emphasizing targeted neuronal population alterations. It compares rabies virus with other neurotropic viruses, highlighting distinct pathogenic strategies and the role of neuroinflammation and systemic factors. The review identifies gaps in understanding the precise pathways linking infection to behavioral disturbances and underscores the need for further research to develop therapeutic strategies addressing both the infectious agent and specific neural networks.

elements_zh.scope_and_question: 狂犬病病毒 和 狂犬病 疾病。该综述的重点是了解 狂犬病病毒 诱导行为和认知变化的分子和细胞机制,重点是有针对性的神经元群体改变及其转化为行为表型。
elements_zh.evidence_base_and_review_method: 该综述整合了对 狂犬病病毒 (RABV)、伪狂犬病病毒 (PRV)、博尔纳病病毒 (BoDV-1)、SARS-CoV-2、尼帕病毒 (NiV)、西尼罗河病毒 (WNV) 和单纯疱疹病毒 1 (HSV-1) 研究的分子、细胞和系统级见解。它包括对这些病毒的比较分析,以确定将感染与行为改变和认知功能障碍联系起来的常见途径。
elements_zh.consensus_and_key_conclusions: 狂犬病病毒 选择性破坏胆碱能、血清素能和谷氨酸/GABA 能途径,同时保留神经元完整性以促进 传播。神经炎症,包括小胶质细胞激活、星形细胞反应和促炎细胞因子的产生,会导致西尼罗河病毒和尼瓦病毒感染中的突触和网络功能障碍,但在不同的病原体中,其他机制占主导地位。肠脑轴和微生物组改变等全身因素(在 SARS-CoV-2 感染中尤其明显)可调节神经递质代谢和神经免疫反应。
elements_zh.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: 该综述强调,虽然神经炎症是某些病毒的一个重要因素,但其他机制在不同的病原体中占主导地位。对于特定神经元群体的改变如何转化为行为表型缺乏详细的了解,并且系统因素在调节这些影响中的作用仍未得到充分探索。
elements_zh.research_and_practice_implications: 需要进一步的研究来阐明 狂犬病病毒 和其他嗜神经病毒诱导行为和认知变化的分子和细胞机制。这包括研究肠脑轴和微生物组改变在调节神经免疫反应和神经递质代谢中的作用。

papers.abstract_zh: 嗜神经病毒通过多种分子和细胞机制诱导行为和认知改变,其范围超出了简单的神经元损伤。对 狂犬病病毒 (RABV)、伪狂犬病病毒 (PRV)、博尔纳病病毒 (BoDV-1)、SARS-CoV-2、尼帕病毒 (NiV)、西尼罗河病毒 (WNV) 和单纯疱疹病毒 1 (HSV-1) 的比较分析揭示了针对特定神经回路的不同致病策略。虽然以小胶质细胞激活、星形细胞反应和促炎细胞因子产生为特征的神经炎症在 WNV 和 NiV 感染中导致突触和网络功能障碍,但其他机制在不同病原体中占主导地位。RABV 选择性破坏胆碱能、血清素能和谷氨酸/GABA 能途径,同时保留神经元完整性以促进 传播,而 BoDV-1 和 SARS-CoV-2 通过持续的免疫激活和内皮损伤诱导多巴胺能和血清素能功能障碍。此外,肠脑轴和微生物组改变等全身因素(在 SARS-CoV-2 感染中尤其明显)可调节神经递质代谢和神经免疫反应。考虑到在感染过程中观察到的甚至弥漫性神经元损失的情况,行为变化可能更多地是由选择性的、依赖于回路的脆弱性引起的,涉及对情绪、认知和运动控制网络的特定破坏。为了清楚地回顾有关靶向神经元群体改变如何转化为行为表型的知识,我们在这里整合了用作模型的这七种嗜神经病毒的分子、细胞和系统级见解,目的是确定将感染与行为变化和认知功能障碍联系起来的常见途径。了解从急性突触操纵到长期神经免疫失调的这些离散机制对于制定针对感染因子和介导急性紊乱和长期神经后遗症的特定神经网络的治疗策略至关重要。

papers.title: Future vaccine priorities in Cambodia: preparedness for emerging infectious diseases.
papers.abstract: Cambodia has achieved substantial progress in immunisation over the past two decades, culminating in one of Southeast Asia's most successful COVID-19 vaccination campaigns. However, the epidemiological landscape is rapidly changing. Climate change, environmental degradation, urbanisation, increasing regional mobility, and intensified human-animal interactions are increasing the risk of emerging infectious diseases, placing Cambodia at the frontline of future epidemic and pandemic threats. papers.title: Infectious Disease Diagnostic Capacity Across Hospital Tiers in China: National Cross-Sectional Survey.
papers.abstract: BACKGROUND: China's notifiable infectious disease surveillance relies on clinical recognition and diagnostic testing, but uneven hospital capacity may affect case ascertainment and interpretation of reported burden. OBJECTIVE: This study aims to assess infectious disease diagnostic capacity across hospital tiers in China, including alignment with notified disease burden, regional variation, diagnostic modalities, and implementation barriers. METHODS: We conducted a national cross-sectional web-based survey of hospitals in China in 2023. After centralized quality control and eligibility screening, 2689 hospitals were included: 124 (4.6%) primary, 1478 (55%) secondary, and 1087 (40.4%) tertiary hospitals. We assessed in-house and send-out testing availability; compared diagnostic availability with national notified incidence and mortality; and examined regional variation, selected diagnostic modalities, and reported barriers. RESULTS: Median in-house diagnostic coverage increased from 11.6% (IQR 9.3%-18.6%) in primary hospitals to 27.9% (IQR 18.6%-37.2%) in secondary hospitals and 39.5% (IQR 27.9%-48.8%) in tertiary hospitals; corresponding overall coverage, including send-out testing, was 14% (IQR 9.3%-23.3%), 32.6% (IQR 23.3%-44.2%), and 44.2% (IQR 30.2%-55.8%), respectively. Tier differences persisted in sensitivity analyses. Diagnostic availability was not consistently aligned with notified disease burden. In-house hepatitis B testing was available in 82.3% (102/124), 98% (1449/1478), and 99.3% (1079/1087) of primary, secondary, and tertiary hospitals, respectively. Pulmonary tuberculosis showed a pronounced tier gradient (26/124, 21% in primary vs 910/1087, 83.7% in tertiary hospitals). Hand, foot, and mouth disease and other infectious diarrheal diseases had limited availability even in tertiary hospitals (380/1087, 35% and 456/1087, 42%, respectively) despite high incidence. Some lower-incidence but high-consequence infections also had limited local capacity, including hemorrhagic fever with renal syndrome (151/1087, 13.9%) and rabies (43/1087, 4%) in tertiary hospitals. Geographic variation was partly consistent with known disease endemicity, with higher testing availability for hemorrhagic fever with renal syndrome in northeastern hospitals, although only 35.9% (55/153) of tertiary hospitals in this region offered in-house testing. Diagnostic depth also varied across tiers: hepatitis B virus (HBV) DNA testing increased from 8.1% (10/124) in primary hospitals to 61.1% (664/1087) in tertiary hospitals. For COVID-19, primary hospitals more frequently reported antigen than nucleic acid testing (57/124, 46% vs 27/124, 21.8%). Lower-tier hospitals more often reported workforce and infrastructure constraints, whereas tertiary hospitals more frequently cited reagent-licensing and fee-schedule barriers. CONCLUSIONS: Among surveyed hospitals, infectious disease diagnostic capacity differed substantially across hospital tiers, varied geographically, and was not consistently aligned with notified disease burden. These disparities extended beyond disease coverage to specific testing modalities and barriers to capacity expansion. These findings support tiered, regionally responsive diagnostic networks that provide essential testing closer to first-contact care while ensuring timely access to specialized diagnostics through reliable, quality-assured referral pathways.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 该研究旨在评估中国各级医院的传染病诊断能力,解决可能影响病例确定和报告疾病负担解释的医院能力参差不齐的问题。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 2023年对中国2689家医院进行了全国横断面网络调查,其中一级医院124家,二级医院1478家,三级医院1087家。
elements_zh.methods: 该调查涉及集中质量控制和资格筛选、评估内部和发送测试的可用性、诊断方式和实施障碍。
elements_zh.main_results: 内部诊断覆盖率从一级医院的11.6%提高到二级医院的27.9%和三级医院的39.5%。包括发送测试在内的总体覆盖率分别为 14%、32.6% 和 44.2%。乙型肝炎检测已广泛应用,但肺结核检测显示出明显的分级梯度。对于低 发病率 但后果严重的感染,特定检测方式的可用性有限,并且地理差异部分与已知的疾病流行情况一致。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 该研究发现,不同级别医院的诊断能力存在显着差异,差异不仅限于疾病覆盖范围,还包括特定的检测方式以及能力扩张的障碍。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现支持分层的、区域响应的诊断网络,该网络提供更接近首次接触护理的基本测试,同时确保通过可靠、有质量保证的转诊途径及时获得专业诊断。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究的设计局限性,包括对自我报告数据的依赖和潜在的报告偏差,可能会影响研究结果的普遍性。证据强度中等。

papers.title: Comparing NGO and government-managed dog vaccination: Implications for vaccination coverage and rabies outcomes in animals and humans in Meru, Tanzania
papers.abstract: Background : Rabies is a fatal but preventable zoonotic disease transmitted primarily by domestic dogs. Mass dog vaccination (MDV) is central to rabies elimination, yet vaccination coverage in endemic settings often remains insufficient and uneven. This study assessed dog vaccination coverage under two contrasting delivery arrangements in Meru, Tanzania: Organised, non-government (NGO)-managed annual MDV campaigns and predominantly owner-initiated vaccination services in government-managed wards. It also examined human rabies exposures and animal rabies cases and identified barriers and facilitators affecting vaccination delivery. Methods : Vaccination data from NGO-managed MDV campaigns (2020–2024) were obtained from Mbwa wa Africa records, and 2025 data were collected during campaign implementation. Vaccination coverage in both NGO and government-managed wards was estimated using household surveys conducted after NGO-managed campaigns and in government-managed wards where no organised annual MDV campaigns were implemented. Data on human exposures and suspected animal cases (2023–2025) were extracted from the Integrated Bite Case Management System. Generalized linear mixed models (GLMMs) were used to compare vaccination coverage between the two settings and to assess the association among vaccination coverage, human exposures, and animal cases. Qualitative interviews were conducted to explore barriers to and facilitators of MDV. Results : Vaccination coverage in NGO-managed wards increased from 45.1% in 2020 to 71% in 2025, while government-managed wards remained low, peaking at 21.9% in 2023 before declining to 8.8% in 2025. GLMM analysis confirmed higher vaccination coverage in NGO-managed wards (IRR = 12.1, 95% CI: 12.1–12.2; p < 0.05). Human exposures and animal cases declined in 2024 but increased in 2025. Animal rabies cases were associated with human exposures. Vaccination coverage was not associated with human exposures (IRR = 1.0, 95% CI: 0.998–1.010, p = 0.730) but was associated with animal cases (IRR =1.02, 95% CI: 1.01–1.04, p = 0.008). Barriers included limited veterinary outreach, vaccination fees, dog handling difficulties, low awareness, and free-roaming dogs. Facilitators included decentralised delivery, free services, and community mobilisation. Conclusion : Organised NGO-managed campaigns were associated with higher vaccination coverage than the predominantly owner-initiated vaccination services available in government-managed wards. However, uneven spatial coverage remained a challenge for district-wide rabies control. The findings highlight the importance of accessible, coordinated, and equitable dog vaccination services integrated with One Health surveillance. One Health impact statement Rabies remains a One Health challenge at the human-animal interface. This study demonstrates that fragmented vaccination delivery and uneven spatial coverage undermine ward-level rabies control, even where high coverage is achieved locally. By integrating mass dog vaccination data with Integrated Bite Case Management (IBCM) surveillance data, we show how disparities in animal health service delivery directly translate into human rabies exposure risk. Importantly, the IBCM datasets analysed in this study were developed through routine cross-sector collaboration between the human health and animal health sectors, illustrating the practical application of the One Health approach in rabies surveillance. The findings provide evidence that coordinated, cross-sectoral planning – linking veterinary vaccination campaigns, human health surveillance, and community engagement – is essential to achieve and sustain elimination targets. This work illustrates how aligning NGO and government strategies within a unified One Health framework can strengthen policy implementation, improve equity in service delivery, and accelerate progress toward “Zero by 30” targets.

papers.title: RVG29-modified reduction-responsive nanomicelles for brain-targeted delivery of a glutaminyl cyclase inhibitor in Alzheimer's disease.
papers.abstract: Although glutaminyl cyclase (QC)-mediated formation of pyroglutamate-modified amyloid-β (pE-Aβ) has been implicated as an upstream pathological event in Alzheimer's disease (AD), the therapeutic translation of small-molecule QC inhibitors remains limited by insufficient brain exposure. Here, we developed a reduction-responsive polymeric micellar platform (designated PIC) based on poly(ethylene glycol) (PEG)-poly(aspartic acid) (PAsp)-poly(valine) (PVal) copolymers. This platform was functionalized with rabies virus glycoprotein-derived peptide 29 (RVG29) to obtain RVG29-PIC-B13 for enhanced brain delivery of B13, an imidazole-based QC inhibitor, and release of its active thiol form. B13 was conjugated to PEG-PAsp-PVal micelles through a disulfide linker, whereas RVG29 was introduced as a brain-targeting ligand to enhance blood-brain barrier transport. RVG29-PIC-B13 formed spherical nanomicelles with an average diameter of 169.9 nm, a drug-loading content of 6.2%, high colloidal stability, and glutathione-triggered release of B13-SH, which retained QC inhibitory activity with an IC 50 of 1.17 μM. RVG29 modification significantly enhanced cellular uptake in bEND.3, PC12, and SH-SY5Y cells, increased transport across a bEND.3 monolayer by 3.12-fold, and elevated brain fluorescence accumulation in vivo by 2.58-fold and 1.96-fold compared with free Cy5 and unmodified micelles, respectively. In 8-month-old 3 × Tg-AD mice, 45-day administration of RVG29-PIC-B13 significantly improved performance in the Morris water maze, Y-maze, open-field, and elevated plus maze assays. Mechanistically, RVG29-PIC-B13 inhibited brain QC activity without markedly altering QC expression, reduced Aβ and pE-Aβ burden, attenuated AT8/AT100-associated tau phosphorylation, and preserved dendritic complexity and spine density. Preliminary hematological and histological analyses indicated acceptable biocompatibility. These findings support RVG29-PIC-B13 as a promising reduction-responsive nanodelivery strategy for enhancing brain delivery of QC inhibitors and improving therapeutic outcomes in AD.

analysis.research_question_and_background: The study aimed to address the limited therapeutic translation of small-molecule glutaminyl cyclase inhibitors in Alzheimer's disease due to insufficient brain exposure.
analysis.study_design_and_population: The study developed a reduction-responsive nanomicellar platform for brain-targeted delivery of a glutaminyl cyclase inhibitor in Alzheimer's disease using 8-month-old 3 × Tg-AD mice.
analysis.methods: The platform was functionalized with RVG29 to enhance brain delivery and release of the active thiol form of B13, an imidazole-based QC inhibitor, through a disulfide linker.
analysis.main_results: RVG29 modification increased cellular uptake in bEND.3, PC12, and SH-SY5Y cells, enhanced transport across a bEND.3 monolayer by 3.12-fold, and elevated brain fluorescence accumulation in vivo by 2.58-fold and 1.96-fold compared with free Cy5 and unmodified micelles, respectively.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The findings suggest that RVG29-PIC-B13 is a promising strategy for enhancing brain delivery of QC inhibitors and improving therapeutic outcomes in Alzheimer's disease.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The results may inform the development of targeted drug delivery systems for Alzheimer's disease, potentially improving the efficacy of glutaminyl cyclase inhibitors.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study's limitations include the use of animal models and the lack of long-term safety data, but the evidence is strong due to the clear demonstration of enhanced brain delivery and therapeutic effects.

analysis.summary_en: This study presents a novel nanomicellar delivery system for brain-targeted administration of a glutaminyl cyclase inhibitor in Alzheimer's disease. The platform, RVG29-PIC-B13, was designed to enhance brain exposure through the use of RVG29 as a brain-targeting ligand. The results showed that RVG29 modification significantly improved cellular uptake, transport across a bEND.3 monolayer, and brain fluorescence accumulation compared to free Cy5 and unmodified micelles. In 8-month-old 3 × Tg-AD mice, the administration of RVG29-PIC-B13 led to improved performance in several behavioral assays, indicating potential therapeutic benefits. Mechanistically, the system inhibited brain glutaminyl cyclase activity, reduced Aβ and pE-Aβ burden, and preserved dendritic complexity and spine density. Preliminary biocompatibility analyses were favorable, but the study's limitations include reliance on animal models and the absence of long-term safety data. These findings support RVG29-PIC-B13 as a promising strategy for enhancing the therapeutic outcomes of glutaminyl cyclase inhibitors in Alzheimer's disease.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 该研究旨在解决由于大脑暴露不足而导致小分子谷氨酰胺酰环化酶抑制剂在阿尔茨海默病中的治疗转化有限的问题。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 该研究开发了一种还原响应纳米胶束平台,使用 8 个月大的 3 × Tg-AD 小鼠,在阿尔茨海默病中脑部靶向递送谷氨酰胺酰环化酶抑制剂。
elements_zh.methods: 该平台使用 RVG29 进行功能化,以通过二硫键连接体增强 B13(一种基于咪唑的 QC 抑制剂)的活性硫醇形式的大脑递送和释放。
elements_zh.main_results: 与游离 Cy5 和未修饰的胶束相比,RVG29 修饰增加了 bEND.3、PC12 和 SH-SY5Y 细胞中的细胞摄取,将跨 bEND.3 单层的转运增强了 3.12 倍,并将体内脑荧光积累分别提高了 2.58 倍和 1.96 倍。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 研究结果表明,RVG29-PIC-B13 是一种有前途的策略,可增强 QC 抑制剂的大脑递送并改善阿尔茨海默病的治疗效果。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些结果可能为阿尔茨海默病靶向药物输送系统的开发提供信息,从而有可能提高谷氨酰胺酰环化酶抑制剂的功效。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究的局限性包括使用动物模型和缺乏长期安全数据,但由于清楚地证明了增强的大脑输送和治疗效果,证据是强有力的。

papers.abstract_zh: 尽管谷氨酰胺酰环化酶 (QC) 介导的焦谷氨酸修饰的淀粉样蛋白 -β (pE-Aβ) 的形成被认为是阿尔茨海默病 (AD) 的上游病理事件,但小分子 QC 抑制剂的治疗转化仍然受到大脑暴露不足的限制。在这里,我们开发了一种基于聚乙二醇(PEG)-聚(天冬氨酸)(PAsp)-聚(缬氨酸)(PVal)共聚物的还原响应聚合物胶束平台(指定为PIC)。该平台使用 狂犬病病毒 糖蛋白衍生肽 29 (RVG29) 进行功能化,以获得 RVG29-PIC-B13,用于增强 B13(一种基于咪唑的 QC 抑制剂)的脑部递送,并释放其活性硫醇形式。B13 通过二硫键与 PEG-PAsp-PVal 胶束缀合,而 RVG29 则作为脑靶向配体引入,以增强血脑屏障转运。RVG29-PIC-B13形成球形纳米胶束,平均直径为169.9 nm,载药量为6.2%,胶体稳定性高,谷胱甘肽触发释放B13-SH,保留了QC抑制活性,IC 50 为1.17 μM。与游离 Cy5 和未修饰的胶束相比,RVG29 修饰显着增强了 bEND.3、PC12 和 SH-SY5Y 细胞中的细胞摄取,使穿过 bEND.3 单层的转运增加了 3.12 倍,并使体内脑荧光积累分别增加了 2.58 倍和 1.96 倍。在 8 个月大的 3 × Tg-AD 小鼠中,RVG29-PIC-B13 给药 45 天显着改善了 Morris 水迷宫、Y 迷宫、开放场和高架十字迷宫测定的性能。从机制上讲,RVG29-PIC-B13 抑制大脑 QC 活性,但不显着改变 QC 表达,减少 Aβ 和 pE-Aβ 负担,减弱 AT8/AT100 相关 tau 磷酸化,并保留树突复杂性和树突棘密度。初步的血液学和组织学分析表明具有可接受的生物相容性。这些发现支持 RVG29-PIC-B13 作为一种有前途的还原响应纳米递送策略,用于增强 QC 抑制剂的大脑递送并改善 AD 的治疗结果。

papers.title: Seroprotection and improved polyfunctional immunity conferred by a YF17D-vectored rabies vaccine
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT Rabies remains a major public-health challenge, with pre-exposure vaccination strategies constrained by the need for multiple doses and repeated healthcare visits. Here we describe YF-RabG, a live-attenuated rabies vaccine candidate based on the yellow fever 17D (YF17D) vaccine backbone that stably expresses the rabies virus glycoprotein (RabG). YF-RabG exhibited an attenuated phenotype and favourable safety profile compared with parental YF17D across several preclinical models, including neonatal and immunocompromised mice. A single immunization induced robust humoral and cell-mediated immune responses in non-human primates. Rabies virus-neutralizing antibody titres readily exceeded the widely accepted correlate of protection in mice, hamsters and non-human primates by several orders. Accordingly, vaccination conferred protection against lethal rabies challenge in a range of stringent mouse models, maintained seroprotective antibody levels for at least one year, and increased following a boost using a licensed rabies vaccine. Furthermore, the YF17D vector was readily adapted to accommodate glycoproteins from distant lyssaviruses, generating protective vaccine candidates against Mokola, Lagos bat and Lleida bat lyssaviruses. Collectively, these findings identify YF-RabG as a promising single-dose rabies vaccine candidate and highlight the versatility of the YF17D platform for lyssavirus vaccine development.

analysis.summary_en: This study introduces YF-RabG, a rabies vaccine candidate based on the yellow fever 17D (YF17D) vaccine backbone that expresses the rabies virus glycoprotein. The research highlights the need for improved rabies vaccination strategies due to the limitations of current multi-dose approaches. The study demonstrates that YF-RabG induces strong immune responses in non-human primates and provides protection against rabies challenge in mouse models. It also shows that the YF17D platform can be adapted to create vaccines against related lyssaviruses. The findings suggest YF-RabG as a potential single-dose vaccine candidate and emphasize the platform's versatility. The study's results are based on preclinical models, which may limit their direct applicability to human populations. The evidence is strong for the vaccine's efficacy in these models, but further human trials are needed to confirm its effectiveness.

papers.title_zh: YF17D 载体 狂犬病 疫苗 赋予血清保护和改善的多功能免疫力
papers.source_body_en: ABSTRACT Rabies remains a major public-health challenge, with pre-exposure vaccination strategies constrained by the need for multiple doses and repeated healthcare visits. Here we describe YF-RabG, a live-attenuated rabies vaccine candidate based on the yellow fever 17D (YF17D) vaccine backbone that stably expresses the rabies virus glycoprotein (RabG). YF-RabG exhibited an attenuated phenotype and favourable safety profile compared with parental YF17D across several preclinical models, including neonatal and immunocompromised mice. A single immunization induced robust humoral and cell-mediated immune responses in non-human primates. Rabies virus-neutralizing antibody titres readily exceeded the widely accepted correlate of protection in mice, hamsters and non-human primates by several orders. Accordingly, vaccination conferred protection against lethal rabies challenge in a range of stringent mouse models, maintained seroprotective antibody levels for at least one year, and increased following a boost using a licensed rabies vaccine. Furthermore, the YF17D vector was readily adapted to accommodate glycoproteins from distant lyssaviruses, generating protective vaccine candidates against Mokola, Lagos bat and Lleida bat lyssaviruses. Collectively, these findings identify YF-RabG as a promising single-dose rabies vaccine candidate and highlight the versatility of the YF17D platform for lyssavirus vaccine development.

papers.title: Evaluation of all three pinniped families to triannual vaccination with an inactivated rabies vaccine
papers.abstract: A recent outbreak of rabies virus has been identified as an emerging epidemic among Cape fur seals ( Arctocephalus pusillus pusillus ) along the southern African coastline. This marks the first large-scale detection of rabies virus in marine mammals and raises significant concerns about potential transmission to other mammals and humans. There is also growing apprehension about the virus’s capacity to spread across national and continental borders, with a potential spillover event occurring into the sub-Antarctic region. Vaccination of wild populations would be a cornerstone to controlling this outbreak. This study investigated whether pinnipeds housed at Ocean Park Corporation (OPC) in Hong Kong developed an immune response to a commercially available inactivated rabies vaccine (Rabisin ® and Nobivac ® ). Sixteen pinnipeds, representing all three pinniped family groups including Californian sea lion ( Zalophus californianus ), Pacific walrus ( Odobenus rosmarus ), Harbor seal ( Phoca vitulina ), and Spotted seal ( Phoca largha ), received a 1 mL dose of an inactivated parenteral vaccine every three years. Historical serum samples collected over five years during routine health examinations were analyzed to assess the duration of the vaccine-induced immune response. The antibody titers indicated that all individuals seroconverted and remained seropositive following vaccination. Although antibody titers declined before administration of the second vaccine dose at the three-year interval, all recorded values remained above the 0.5 IU/L threshold considered indicative of an adequate (presumed protective) immune response to rabies vaccination. The study concluded that the parenteral vaccine was safe for use across all three pinniped families in the species studied and that a single dose provided protective immunity for approximately three years, after which booster vaccination was recommended.

analysis.summary_en: This study evaluated the effectiveness of triannual vaccination with an inactivated rabies vaccine in pinnipeds at Ocean Park Corporation in Hong Kong. The research was motivated by a recent rabies outbreak among Cape fur seals in southern Africa, which raised concerns about transmission to other mammals and humans. The study found that all sixteen pinnipeds seroconverted and remained seropositive, with antibody titers above the 0.5 IU/L threshold. The authors concluded that the vaccine was safe and provided protective immunity for about three years, recommending booster doses. The findings suggest that triannual vaccination could be a useful strategy for controlling rabies in pinniped populations. However, the study's reliance on historical serum samples limits the confidence in its conclusions, and the evidence strength is moderate.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 最近,狂犬病病毒 的 暴发 已被确定为南部非洲海岸线海角海狗(Arctocephalus pusillus pusillus)中的一种新流行病。这标志着首次在海洋哺乳动物中大规模检测到 狂犬病病毒,并引发了对其他哺乳动物和人类潜在 传播 的严重担忧。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 本研究调查了香港海洋公园公司 (OPC) 饲养的鳍足类动物是否将 免疫应答 发展为市售的灭活 狂犬病 疫苗(Rabisin ® 和 Nobivac ® )。代表所有三个鳍足类家族的 16 只鳍足类动物,包括加州海狮 (Zalophus californianus)、太平洋海象 (Odobenus rosmarus)、斑海豹 (Phoca vitulina) 和斑海豹 (Phoca largha),每三年接受 1 mL 剂量的灭活注射剂 疫苗。
elements_zh.methods: 对常规健康检查期间收集的五年历史血清样本进行分析,以评估 疫苗 诱导的 免疫应答 的持续时间。
elements_zh.main_results: 抗体滴度表明所有个体在 疫苗接种 后均发生血清转化并保持血清阳性。尽管在三年间隔内给予第二次 疫苗 剂量之前抗体滴度下降,但所有记录值仍高于 0.5 IU/L 阈值,被认为表明 免疫应答 至 狂犬病 疫苗接种 具有足够的(假定保护性)。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 该研究得出的结论是,胃肠外注射剂 疫苗 对于所研究物种的所有三个鳍足科家族来说都是安全的,并且单剂量可提供约三年的保护性免疫力,之后推荐使用加强剂 疫苗。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果表明,三年一次的 狂犬病 与灭活的 狂犬病 疫苗 可能是控制鳍足类种群中 狂犬病 暴发 的可行策略,这可能有助于防止其他哺乳动物和人类感染 传播。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 提供的证据没有报告 疫苗 在三年间隔之后的长期安全性或有效性,也没有提供用于测量抗体滴度的具体测定的详细信息。由于依赖历史血清样本且缺乏详细的随访数据,证据强度中等。

papers.title: Association between socioeconomic factors and rabies-related knowledge, attitudes and practices among dog owners in Mungwi District, Zambia
papers.abstract: Rabies remains an important public health concern in many low- and middle-income countries, including Zambia, where domestic dogs are the principal source of human rabies transmission. This study assessed the association between socioeconomic characteristics and rabies-related knowledge, attitudes, and preventive practices among registered dog owners in selected high-risk communities of Mungwi District, Zambia. An analytical cross-sectional study was conducted among 162 registered dog owners using a pretested structured questionnaire administered through face-to-face interviews. Descriptive statistics and multivariable linear regression analyses were used to assess associations between socioeconomic characteristics and knowledge, attitude, practice, and overall KAP scores. Of the 162 respondents, 60.5% had high knowledge, 39.5% had favourable attitudes, and 26.5% reported desirable preventive practices. Most respondents correctly identified dog bites as the principal route of rabies transmission and recognised dog vaccination as an important preventive measure. However, participation in community rabies-control activities remained limited, and some respondents reported reliance on traditional treatment following dog bites. Multivariable analyses showed domain-specific associations. Higher education was associated with higher knowledge, attitude, and overall KAP scores, while higher income was associated with higher knowledge, attitude, practice, and overall KAP scores. Employment status was negatively associated with knowledge but positively associated with attitude and overall KAP scores, and was not significantly associated with preventive-practice scores after adjustment. Residence type was associated with knowledge, preventive practices, and overall KAP, with rural respondents having lower knowledge scores and both rural and peri-urban respondents having lower preventive-practice and overall KAP scores than urban respondents. Socioeconomic and geographic characteristics were differentially associated with rabies-related KAP among registered dog owners in the selected high-risk communities. The findings indicate that favourable knowledge and attitudes did not consistently correspond with desirable preventive practices, particularly among rural and lower-income respondents. These findings may inform targeted rabies-prevention strategies, while the cross-sectional design means that the observed associations should not be interpreted as causal.

analysis.summary_en: This study investigated the association between socioeconomic factors and rabies-related knowledge, attitudes, and practices among dog owners in Mungwi District, Zambia. A cross-sectional survey of 162 registered dog owners revealed that 60.5% had high knowledge, 39.5% had favourable attitudes, and 26.5% reported desirable preventive practices. However, the study found that knowledge and attitudes did not consistently translate into preventive actions, especially among rural and lower-income individuals. These results may guide targeted prevention strategies in high-risk communities.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 狂犬病 仍然是许多低收入和中等收入国家的重要公共卫生问题,其中包括赞比亚,家犬是人类 狂犬病 传播 的主要来源。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 一项分析性横断面研究在 162 名注册狗主人中进行,使用预先测试的结构化问卷,通过面对面访谈进行。
elements_zh.methods: 使用描述性统计和多变量线性回归分析来评估社会经济特征与知识、态度、实践和整体 KAP 分数之间的关联。
elements_zh.main_results: 在 162 名受访者中,60.5% 的人有较高的知识,39.5% 的人有良好的态度,26.5% 的人表示有良好的预防措施。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 高等教育与较高的知识、态度和整体 KAP 得分相关,而较高的收入则与较高的知识、态度、实践和整体 KAP 得分相关。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果表明,良好的知识和态度并不总是符合理想的预防措施,特别是在农村和低收入受访者中。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 这些发现可能会为有针对性的 狂犬病 预防策略提供信息,而横截面设计意味着观察到的关联不应被解释为因果关系。

papers.title: Evaluation of integrated community-based surveillance within the 4S network in Senegal: implications for early detection of epidemic and zoonotic events
papers.abstract: Abstract Background Community-based surveillance integrated into the 4S network (Syndromic Surveillance System in Senegal) is an innovative approach designed to strengthen the early detection and reporting of diseases with epidemic potential, zoonoses, and unusual events through the active involvement of community stakeholders. Piloted in Senegal across three sites, Darou Salam (Pikine), Agnam Civol (Matam), and Dalaba (Kédougou), this strategy has proven its effectiveness in mobilizing community actors, complementing existing health systems, and detecting human and animal health events. Method The evaluation combined quantitative surveys of 83 community stakeholders and healthcare professionals with qualitative research comprising 44 semi-structured interviews and 9 focus groups. A descriptive analysis was conducted on the collected quantitative data and the database of alerts issued by community stakeholders. A thematic analysis was conducted on the qualitative data to contextualize the quantitative results. Results The results show strong community engagement, a revitalisation of the Integrated Community Surveillance and Alert Committees (CVAC.i), and improved detection of health indicators, including maternal deaths, suspected measles, rabies, and haemorrhagic fevers. The system facilitated the reporting of 179 alerts during the evaluation period, of which 88.3% were verified by healthcare professionals. However, logistical, human, digital, and financial constraints persist, raising questions about the model’s large-scale feasibility and longer-term sustainability. Conclusion The Community-based surveillance in Senegal illustrates the importance of a participatory, cross-sectoral approach to strengthening health system resilience. Its long-term sustainability will depend on innovative funding mechanisms, the formalization of the CVACs’ role, and sustainable cross-sectoral collaboration.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 该研究旨在评估基于社区的 监测 融入塞内加尔 4S 网络的有效性,通过社区利益相关者的积极参与,及早发现具有流行潜力的疾病、人畜共患病和异常事件。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 该评估在塞内加尔的三个地点进行:Darou Salam (Pikine)、Agnam Civol (Matam) 和 Dalaba (Kédougou),通过定量和定性方法涉及 83 个社区利益相关者和医疗保健专业人员。
elements_zh.methods: 该评估结合了定量调查和定性研究,包括 44 次半结构化访谈和 9 个焦点小组,以评估社区参与度和健康指标检测。
elements_zh.main_results: 结果显示,社区参与度很高,对孕产妇死亡、疑似麻疹、狂犬病 和出血热等健康指标的检测有所改善,并报告了 179 个警报,其中 88.3% 得到了医疗保健专业人员的验证。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者将研究结果解释为证明了参与性跨部门方法对于加强卫生系统复原力的重要性,该系统的长期可持续性取决于创新的融资机制和可持续的跨部门合作。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果可为其他地区实施类似的基于社区的 监测 系统提供参考,加强疾病和人畜共患病的早期发现和报告,并提高卫生系统的复原力。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究的局限性包括后勤、人力、数字和财务限制,这引发了对该模型的大规模可行性和长期可持续性的质疑。

papers.title: Epidemiological pattern and distribution of animal-bite cases presenting to a tertiary anti-rabies clinic in Kashmir valley: a retrospective record-based study
papers.abstract: Rabies remains a critical public health issue globally, particularly in India where high mortality rates and socio-economic impacts persist. Despite effective post-exposure prophylaxis (PEP), cases often go unreported or poorly managed due to underreporting and limited healthcare access. In the Kashmir region of Jammu & Kashmir, there has been a notable increase in dog bites, but data on other types of animal bites and trends is limited. This study aims to provide a comprehensive analysis of animal bite incidents in the Kashmir Valley, including the types of animals involved, the sites of exposure, and the severity of injuries. The research seeks to address data gaps and underreporting issues to improve public health responses and preventive measures. A retrospective record based study was conducted using data from the Anti-Rabies Clinic (ARC) at Shri Maharaja Hari Singh (SMHS) Hospital, Srinagar, for the year 2023. Data was hand-copied and transcribed into Microsoft Excel 2021 for analysis. Descriptive statistical techniques were used to assess demographic trends, clinic-attending animal-bite case, and characteristics of animal bites. The study recorded 8,269 animal bite cases, with a predominance of males (73.12%) and adults aged 25–54 years (60.23%). Dogs were the most frequent source of bites (5,512 cases), followed by cats (2,318 cases). The majority of bites were on the lower limbs (4,758 cases), with Category 3 injuries being the most common (72.58%). The study demonstrates a substantial burden of animal bites in the Kashmir Valley, with dogs being the predominant source and Category III injuries representing the majority of exposures.. Effective measures should include regular stray dog population control through capture and sterilization programs, community education on avoiding stray dogs, enhanced vaccination initiatives for stray populations, and improved waste management to reduce stray dog attraction.

papers.title: Visualization and Morphological Analysis of Individual Oligodendrocytes in the Mouse White Matter.
papers.abstract: Myelin formation by oligodendrocytes is essential for the regulation of the conduction velocity and proper brain function. To ensure accurate information processing in response to experiences such as sensory stimuli and learning, oligodendrocytes adjust their number and morphology. In addition, oligodendrocyte morphology changes with senescence and in the presence of neurodegenerative diseases. Thus, visualizing oligodendrocytes and analyzing their morphology is crucial for understanding how our brains change under such conditions. Herein, we describe the methods for labeling and analyzing the morphologies of individual oligodendrocytes in mouse white matter at the light microscopic level. PDGFRa-CreERT2:Tau-mGFP and PLP-CreERT2:Tau-mGFP mice enable us to visualize and analyze later-born or early-born oligodendrocyte morphology. In addition, sparse oligodendrocyte labeling with attenuated rabies virus expressing GFP enables the visualization and morphological analysis of individual oligodendrocytes in various brain white matter regions without the need for transgenic animals. Furthermore, the combination with immunostaining in thick tissues enables the identification of labeled oligodendrocytes and myelin sheaths, as well as their interactions with neuronal axons. These methods are suitable for revealing how oligodendrocytes adapt their morphologies depending on environmental stimuli or pathological conditions.

papers.abstract_zh: 少突胶质细胞形成髓鞘对于调节传导速度和维持正常脑功能至关重要。为了确保对如感觉刺激和学习等经验的准确信息处理,少突胶质细胞会调整其数量和形态。此外,少突胶质细胞的形态也会随着衰老和神经退行性疾病的发生而发生变化。因此,对少突胶质细胞进行可视化和形态学分析对于理解我们的大脑在这些条件下的变化至关重要。本文描述了在光学显微镜水平上对小鼠白质中单个少突胶质细胞进行标记和形态学分析的方法。PDGFRa-CreERT2:Tau-mGFP和PLP-CreERT2:Tau-mGFP小鼠使我们能够可视化和分析晚期出生或早期出生的少突胶质细胞的形态。此外,使用减弱的狂犬病病毒表达GFP的稀疏少突胶质细胞标记方法,可以在无需转基因动物的情况下,对各种脑白质区域中的单个少突胶质细胞进行可视化和形态学分析。此外,与厚组织免疫染色相结合,可以识别标记的少突胶质细胞和髓鞘,以及它们与神经元轴突的相互作用。这些方法适用于揭示少突胶质细胞如何根据环境刺激或病理条件调整其形态。

analysis_zh.methods: 这些方法包括使用表达 GFP 的减毒 狂犬病病毒 标记单个少突胶质细胞,并将其与厚组织中的免疫染色相结合,以识别标记的少突胶质细胞和髓鞘,以及它们与神经元轴突的相互作用。
analysis_zh.main_results: 该研究直接观察了在光学显微镜水平上可视化和分析小鼠白质中单个少突胶质细胞形态的能力。
analysis_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者将他们的发现解释为证明这些方法适用于揭示少突胶质细胞如何根据环境刺激或病理条件调整其形态。
analysis_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现可以帮助理解少突胶质细胞如何适应其形态以响应环境刺激或病理条件,这可能对神经科学研究和神经系统疾病的研究产生影响。

papers.title: Parvalbumin interneuron circuit sharpens orientation tuning via the extraclassical surround in cat V1
papers.abstract: Parvalbumin-expressing (PV) inhibitory neurons are central to cortical gain control, yet optogenetic studies disagree on whether they sharpen orientation tuning or merely rescale responses. Because this work has been performed almost exclusively in rodents, which lack orientation columns and an orientation-matched extraclassical surround, the contribution of surround circuitry has remained untested. Here we combine cell-type-specific rabies-virus tracing with optogenetics to activate or suppress PV circuits in cat primary visual cortex, and measure single-neuron orientation tuning for stimuli confined to the classical receptive field or extending into the extraclassical surround. Activating PV circuits sharpened tuning progressively with illumination power for classical-receptive-field stimuli, but left tuning unchanged once the surround was engaged; conversely, suppressing them broadened tuning only for surround-engaging stimuli and left classical-receptive-field tuning unchanged. This double dissociation places PV circuitry in the causal path that sets tuning width and identifies surround suppression as the inhibition it supplies: where the surround is not recruited there is little PV-mediated inhibition to remove, and where it is, removing that inhibition widens tuning. PV-dependent sharpening is therefore bounded by the receptive-field architecture through which the population is recruited, not by a fixed property of the PV population itself.

analysis.research_question_and_background: The study aimed to investigate the role of parvalbumin-expressing (PV) inhibitory neurons in cortical gain control, specifically whether they sharpen orientation tuning or merely rescale responses. The background highlights that previous optogenetic studies have yielded conflicting results on this matter.
analysis.study_design_and_population: The study was conducted in the primary visual cortex of cats, utilizing cell-type-specific rabies-virus tracing combined with optogenetics to activate or suppress PV circuits. The research focused on measuring single-neuron orientation tuning for stimuli confined to the classical receptive field or extending into the extraclassical surround.
analysis.methods: The methods involved combining cell-type-specific rabies-virus tracing with optogenetics to manipulate PV circuits in the cat primary visual cortex. Single-neuron orientation tuning was measured for stimuli restricted to the classical receptive field or extending into the extraclassical surround.
analysis.main_results: Activating PV circuits progressively sharpened orientation tuning for classical-receptive-field stimuli but left tuning unchanged once the surround was engaged. Conversely, suppressing PV circuits broadened tuning only for surround-engaging stimuli and had no effect on classical-receptive-field tuning.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The findings suggest that PV circuitry is causally involved in setting tuning width, with surround suppression being the specific inhibition it provides. This study introduces a novel understanding of how PV neurons interact with receptive-field architecture to influence orientation tuning.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: These results contribute to the understanding of neural mechanisms underlying orientation tuning in the visual cortex, which may have implications for studying sensory processing and potential therapeutic interventions in neurological disorders.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study is limited to cats, which may affect generalizability to other species. The evidence is strong, as it is based on direct manipulation and measurement of PV circuits in a relevant model system.

analysis.summary_en: This study investigates the role of parvalbumin-expressing (PV) inhibitory neurons in cortical gain control, specifically their effect on orientation tuning in the cat primary visual cortex. Using a combination of rabies-virus tracing and optogenetics, the researchers activated or suppressed PV circuits and measured single-neuron orientation tuning for stimuli confined to the classical receptive field or extending into the extraclassical surround. The results showed that activating PV circuits progressively sharpened tuning for classical stimuli but had no effect on surround stimuli, while suppressing PV circuits broadened tuning only for surround stimuli. These findings suggest that PV circuitry is causally involved in setting tuning width, with surround suppression being the specific inhibition it provides. The study contributes to understanding the neural mechanisms underlying orientation tuning and may have implications for sensory processing research. However, the study is limited to cats, which may affect generalizability to other species.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 该研究旨在研究表达小清蛋白(PV)的抑制性神经元在皮质增益控制中的作用,特别是它们是否会增强方向调整或仅仅重新调整反应。背景强调,之前的光遗传学研究在这个问题上产生了相互矛盾的结果。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 该研究在猫的初级视觉皮层中进行,利用细胞类型特异性 狂犬病 病毒追踪结合光遗传学来激活或抑制 PV 回路。该研究的重点是测量仅限于经典感受野或延伸到超经典周围环境的刺激的单神经元方向调整。
elements_zh.methods: 这些方法涉及将细胞类型特异性 狂犬病 病毒追踪与光遗传学相结合,以操纵猫初级视觉皮层中的 PV 回路。针对仅限于经典感受野或延伸到超经典周围环境的刺激,测量单神经元方向调整。
elements_zh.main_results: 激活 PV 电路会逐渐锐化经典感受场刺激的方向调整,但一旦环绕声接合,调整就会保持不变。相反,抑制 PV 电路仅拓宽了对周围环境刺激的调谐,并且对经典感受野调谐没有影响。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 研究结果表明,PV 电路与设置调谐宽度有因果关系,而环绕抑制是它提供的特定抑制。这项研究引入了对 PV 神经元如何与感受野结构相互作用以影响方向调整的新理解。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些结果有助于理解视觉皮层定向调节的神经机制,这可能对研究神经系统疾病的感觉处理和潜在的治疗干预具有影响。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究仅限于猫,这可能会影响对其他物种的推广。证据是强有力的,因为它是基于相关模型系统中光伏电路的直接操作和测量。

papers.title_zh: 小白蛋白中间神经元电路通过 cat V1 中的超经典环绕增强方向调整
papers.source_body_en: Parvalbumin-expressing (PV) inhibitory neurons are central to cortical gain control, yet optogenetic studies disagree on whether they sharpen orientation tuning or merely rescale responses. Because this work has been performed almost exclusively in rodents, which lack orientation columns and an orientation-matched extraclassical surround, the contribution of surround circuitry has remained untested. This double dissociation places PV circuitry in the causal path that sets tuning width and identifies surround suppression as the inhibition it supplies: where the surround is not recruited there is little PV-mediated inhibition to remove, and where it is, removing that inhibition widens tuning. PV-dependent sharpening is therefore bounded by the receptive-field architecture through which the population is recruited, not by a fixed property of the PV population itself.
papers.abstract_zh: 表达小白蛋白(PV)的抑制性神经元是皮质增益控制的核心,但光遗传学研究对于它们是否会增强方向调节或仅仅重新调整反应存在分歧。由于这项工作几乎完全是在啮齿动物身上进行的,这些动物缺乏方向柱和方向匹配的超古典环绕声,因此环绕电路的贡献尚未经过测试。在这里,我们将细胞类型特异性 狂犬病 病毒追踪与光遗传学结合起来,激活或抑制猫初级视觉皮层中的 PV 回路,并测量单神经元方向调整,以限制经典感受野或延伸到超经典周围的刺激。激活 PV 电路会随着经典感受场刺激的照明功率逐渐锐化调谐,但一旦启用环绕声,调谐就会保持不变;相反,抑制它们只会扩大对周围环境刺激的调谐,并使经典感受野调谐保持不变。这种双重解离将 PV 电路置于因果路径中,该路径设置调谐宽度并将环绕声抑制识别为它提供的抑制:在没有招募环绕声的地方,几乎没有 PV 介导的抑制需要消除,而在有这种抑制的地方,消除该抑制会扩大调谐范围。因此,PV 相关的锐化受到招募群体的感受野架构的限制,而不是受到 PV 群体本身的固定属性的限制。

analysis_zh.research_question_and_background: 该研究旨在研究表达小清蛋白(PV)的抑制性神经元在皮质增益控制中的作用,特别是它们是否会增强方向调整或仅仅重新调整反应。背景强调,之前的光遗传学研究在这个问题上产生了相互矛盾的结果。
analysis_zh.study_design_and_population: 该研究在猫的初级视觉皮层中进行,利用细胞类型特异性 狂犬病 病毒追踪结合光遗传学来激活或抑制 PV 回路。该研究的重点是测量仅限于经典感受野或延伸到超经典周围环境的刺激的单神经元方向调整。
analysis_zh.methods: 这些方法涉及将细胞类型特异性 狂犬病 病毒追踪与光遗传学相结合,以操纵猫初级视觉皮层中的 PV 回路。针对仅限于经典感受野或延伸到超经典周围环境的刺激,测量单神经元方向调整。
analysis_zh.main_results: 激活 PV 电路会逐渐锐化经典感受场刺激的方向调整,但一旦环绕声接合,调整就会保持不变。相反,抑制 PV 电路仅拓宽了对周围环境刺激的调谐,并且对经典感受野调谐没有影响。
analysis_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 研究结果表明,PV 电路与设置调谐宽度有因果关系,而环绕抑制是它提供的特定抑制。这项研究引入了对 PV 神经元如何与感受野结构相互作用以影响方向调整的新理解。
analysis_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些结果有助于理解视觉皮层定向调节的神经机制,这可能对研究神经系统疾病的感觉处理和潜在的治疗干预具有影响。
analysis_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究仅限于猫,这可能会影响对其他物种的推广。证据是强有力的,因为它是基于相关模型系统中光伏电路的直接操作和测量。

papers.title: Distribution of tetracycline-resistant phenotypes in Escherichia coli and Proteus mirabilis isolates from wildlife
papers.abstract: Antimicrobial resistance (AMR) is increasingly recognized in wildlife, reflecting environmental exposure to antimicrobial agents. Among wild carnivores, red foxes (Vulpes vulpes) are considered useful sentinels for monitoring environmental dissemination of resistant bacteria. Escherichia coli and Proteus mirabilis are common intestinal commensals that can acquire and transfer resistance determinants. In Romania, oxytetracycline is included as a biomarker in oral anti-rabies vaccine baits distributed to fox populations, potentially contributing to the selection of resistant bacteria in these animals. This study aimed to evaluate the phenotypic resistance to tetracycline in E. mirabilis isolates recovered from wild red foxes in Romania and to assess the potential influence of environmental exposure to tetracyclines from anti-rabies vaccination baits. Thirty bacterial isolates, including twenty E. coli, respectively ten P. mirabilis strains, previously identified using the Vitek 2 Compact system were examined for tetracycline susceptibility using the Kirby-Bauer disk diffusion method, according to standard interpretative criteria. coli isolates, 11 (55%) were resistant to tetracycline, while 9 (45%) were susceptible. mirabilis isolates (100%) exhibited resistance to tetracycline. These findings confirm the presence of tetracycline-resistant phenotypes among enteric bacteria from wild red foxes. The detection of tetracycline-resistant E. mirabilis in wild red foxes may reflect both intrinsic and environmentally influenced resistance, possibly linked to oxytetracycline exposure from vaccination baits. Ongoing antimicrobial resistance monitoring in wildlife supports the One Health approach to understanding environmental antimicrobial dissemination.
